15. (Currently Amended) A method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __wherein the information is dynamically generated based on real-time server load metrics and is not merely stored application information__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker that evaluates the dynamically generated information to determine server availability and capacity__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature __distinct from the resource identifier__, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker receives the http request and processes the unique signature to route the request to the selected first server computer based on the dynamically generated information__.
